mentions.name: The Password App
mentions.description: This macOS desktop application uses browser agents to automatically update old and compromised passwords, and includes a Chrome extension for navigation. It began as a personal side project after the builder received a compromised password email and launched a couple of weeks ago.
mentions.problem: Old and compromised passwords need to be updated after a breach, such as receiving a compromised password email.
mentions.source_excerpt:
Working on https://thepassword.app

It's a macOS desktop application that uses browser agents to update your old and compromised passwords.
